authorizationSource.answer: Yes—adopt P368-BINDING for PG366-W03-R1 and fixture 367 only

scope.authorizedUse: Use the exact P368-BINDING terms below as a NEW, scoped TEST_ONLY eligibility rule for subsequent Director adjudication of the 3600-second candidate in the named fixture.

p368BindingTerms.minimumDuration: A short rest requires 3600 consecutive in-world seconds per character.
p368BindingTerms.wakefulness: The character remains awake throughout the interval.
p368BindingTerms.interruptionAndReset: Combat, hostile attack or damage, travel, strenuous labor, spellcasting, Weave activity, or other strenuous activity interrupts and resets the character's qualifying interval; the character must begin a new 3600-consecutive-second interval.
p368BindingTerms.clocks: World, effect, and source clocks continue to advance normally during the interval.
p368BindingTerms.benefitAndLimits: Eligibility alone grants no benefit. Safety and supply sufficiency must be separately bound, and an explicit completion/settlement is required before applying any benefit. Existing recovery limits and recovery authority remain in force.

ownerAuthorization.ownerReply: Yes—adopt P368-BINDING for PG366-W03-R1 and fixture 367 only

exclusions: This is not a canonical rule and does not promote or change any canonical source.
It does not mutate or amend fixture 367.
It does not assert a campaign occurrence or runtime event.
It does not establish wakefulness, safety, or supply sufficiency in fixture 367; those remain subject to evidence and Director adjudication.
It grants no rest benefit, RP recovery, Dissonance reset, or other settlement.
It does not settle RP, seal W03, close PG200-B06, accept or apply the spell identity, or change the spell queue.
It has no scope outside PG366-W03-R1 and the named fixture.
